display.purpose: The ScaleFindr wordmark in the header.

label.purpose: Hints, the tagline, and figure names.

mono.purpose: File names and the equation in a figure note.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Labels, notes, and controls that sit on the map.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Pressable controls scale to 0.97 on active. Reduced motion removes the scale.

motion.name: switch
motion.purpose: The switch knob slides and the track changes colour.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Export, import, and the measure actions that commit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2dd4bf; color: #042f2a; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; transition: transform 120ms ease-out, filter 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5eead4; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Sample files, rename, export, and other quiet actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #e2e8f0; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.15); border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; transition: transform 120ms ease-out, background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5eead4; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Region search and the Polygon name field.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); border-radius: 8px; background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); color: #f1f5f9; caret-color: #2dd4bf; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #2dd4bf; outline: 2px solid #5eead4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section Title
components.description: The numbered sidebar sections. There is no separate navigation bar.
components.css: .ds-section { margin: 0 0 12px; color: #f1f5f9; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: Shows or hides a Polygon. The knob stays inside the pill.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 44px; height: 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: #0f766e; padding: 0; } .ds-switch-knob { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 20px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); }

components.name: Inset List
components.description: Region results and the figure readout.
components.css: .ds-list { border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); border-radius: 12px; background: rgb(27 39 61 / 0.6); overflow: hidden; } .ds-list-row { min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; color: #e2e8f0; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-list-row + .ds-list-row { border-top: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); }

narrative.overview:
The map is the work. The sidebar is the instrument panel beside it: import, Polygon list, then region search, in that order. Colour is scarce. Teal means the action you can take or the thing that is selected. Everything else stays on night navy so the basemap and the Polygon remain the brightest objects in the view.

This record describes the interface that is already built. It is an Operate surface: a geologist places an outline, reads a number, and exports a picture.
keyCharacteristics: Night navy panels, one teal accent.
Inter for the interface. Monospace and tabular figures for measurements.
Hairline white borders. Depth comes from a darker or lighter surface, plus a small shadow on things that float over the map.
The map keeps the centre of the screen. The sidebar is 380px from the large breakpoint up, and the map sits above it on a phone.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal teal and Selected teal are the only accents on a working screen. Warning amber and danger red are for a problem or a delete, not for decoration.

rules.name: The Figure Rule
rules.body: A length, an area, or the map scale bar uses tabular numbers. The scale bar is 15px and weight 600 so it survives in an exported PNG.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Sidebar rows and secondary buttons do not cast a shadow. A border at white 10% or 15%, or a shift to Inset, is enough.

dos: Do keep primary actions on Signal teal (#2dd4bf) with Ink on teal (#042f2a).
Do keep selected rows and the switch-on state on Selected teal (#0f766e).
Do keep controls at least 44px tall.
Do use tabular numbers for lengths, areas, and the scale bar.
Do leave the map as the largest region, with the scale bar centred and readable in a PNG.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour for ordinary actions.
Don't put a shadow on a sidebar row that is already sitting on Panel.
Don't cover the zoom controls with the region name or the ScaleFindr mark.
Don't shrink body fields below 16px on a phone.
Don't invent a new corner size. Use 8px for controls and 12px for grouped panels.
